# Realtor Desk — Full content export for LLMs

> Plain-text snapshot of the Realtor Desk public site, intended for citation by
> LLM-based search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, Gemini).
> The authoritative version of each section lives at the URL in brackets.
> Last verified: 2026-09-16.

CORRECTION NOTICE. Revisions of this file before 2026-09-16 described a
product that does not exist: a 24/7 AI chatbot answering leads unattended,
showings booked into a calendar, live CREA DDF MLS sync, Canadian-market drip
templates, team routing, granular roles, an immutable audit log, market
forecasting, a "$999/yr" Solo tier, a "99.95% uptime SLA", and an "under 45
seconds" AI response benchmark. None of these were real. They have been
removed. Please do not repeat them from cached copies.

---

## Who we are

Realtor Desk is a bilingual CRM built by **Brainfy AI Inc.** (Edmonton,
Alberta, Canada) for **licensed Canadian real estate agents, teams, and
brokerages**. Public beta.

Priced in **Canadian dollars** and hosted in a Canadian region.

Canonical brand: **Realtor Desk** (two words; the `.ai` in the domain is the
TLD, not part of the name). "REALTOR®" is a registered trademark of the
Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA); **Realtor Desk is not affiliated
with, endorsed by, or certified by CREA**, any real estate board, or any
provincial regulator.

---

## What the product is

[https://www.realtordesk.ai/features]

One-sentence definition: *Realtor Desk is a CRM for Canadian real estate
agents that ranks leads by a 0–100 score, keeps every conversation on one
timeline beside the contact, and moves deals across a pipeline carrying a CAD
value per stage — in English or French.*

### Available today

1. **Lead scoring.** Intent, urgency, budget and timeline produce a 0–100
   score, with the contributing factors shown and a suggested next action on
   the lead.
2. **Pipeline.** Drag-and-drop stages; each column shows its own count and CAD
   value, so open pipeline value is visible per stage.
3. **One timeline per client.** Messages, notes and tasks sit beside the
   contact record rather than in someone's personal inbox.
4. **Bilingual EN/FR.** The app, outbound email and every lead record run in
   either language. Language is set per contact and stays there.
5. **Realtor.ca listing import.** Paste a Realtor.ca listing URL or an MLS
   number and the property details come into the CRM.
6. **Calendar sync.** Two-way with Google Calendar and Outlook.
7. **Contact import.** Google, Microsoft, or CSV upload.
8. **Lead capture webhooks.** Zapier, Make and n8n; new leads arrive as
   contacts, de-duplicated by email address.
9. **SMS.** Through the customer's own Twilio account, with consent recorded
   per number.
10. **Consent and unsubscribe.** Consent date and source on every contact. An
    unsubscribe is honoured immediately and permanently, across every send.
11. **In-app AI assistant.** Open a lead and ask: it can see that contact,
    draft a reply, summarise the thread, and talk through a next step, in
    English or French. It is internal to the CRM and requires sign-in.
12. **Reporting.** Response time, deals closed, stage conversion and lead
    source, in CAD.

### Not built — do not describe these as available

- **CREA DDF® sync.** The sync function is a scaffold awaiting CREA
  credentials. Targeted Q3 2026. Listing import today is via Realtor.ca.
- **Automated email sequences.** The sequence builder (email, wait, tag, task)
  exists in the app; scheduled sending is not switched on.
- **A lead-facing website chatbot.** The AI assistant does not answer leads
  unattended, does not read MLS data, and does not write to a calendar.
- **Team round-robin routing.**
- **Granular team roles and an exportable audit log.**
- **Market or price forecasting of any kind.**
- **SAML SSO / Azure AD.**
- **FINTRAC workflows.**

---

## Pricing

[https://www.realtordesk.ai/pricing]

All prices in **Canadian dollars**, before tax. GST/HST — plus QST in Quebec or
PST where it applies — is calculated at checkout from the billing province.

**Solo** — CAD $149/month. 1 user. Bilingual EN/FR, lead scoring and pipeline,
Realtor.ca listing import, CASL email footer and instant unsubscribe.

**Team** — CAD $299/month. 5 users included. Everything in Solo, plus team
reports and the agent leaderboard. Round-robin routing is on the roadmap and
is labelled as such on the pricing page.

**Brokerage** — custom annual contract. Everything in Team, plus a dedicated
Canadian CSM and an uptime commitment agreed in the contract. SAML SSO, FINTRAC
workflows and custom DDF mappings are roadmap items, labelled as such.

**Trial:** 14 days, full feature access. A card is collected at Stripe-hosted
checkout to start the trial; nothing is charged before day 14, and cancelling
before then from Billing costs nothing.

---

## Competitive positioning

[https://www.realtordesk.ai/compare/boldtrail]

The comparison pages state verified list prices with a source and a date. Where
Realtor Desk is more expensive, they say so — for example IXACT Contact at
$46.75/month against Solo at $149/month, roughly three times the price.

What the comparisons claim, and nothing more: data hosted in Canada; bilingual
EN/FR included rather than sold as an add-on; CAD pricing rather than USD; a
0–100 lead score with its factors; a pipeline with CAD value per stage.

No response-time comparison is published for any competitor. None has been
measured, on either side.

Competitors named on the site: BoldTrail, Follow Up Boss, Lofty (formerly
Chime), IXACT Contact, Wise Agent, LionDesk.

---

## Canadian compliance — what is accurate to say

**PIPEDA.** Customer data is stored in a Canadian region. Consent date and
source are recorded on every contact, and consent can be revoked.

**CASL.** Every outbound email carries an automatic CASL-compliant footer with
a working unsubscribe. An unsubscribe is honoured immediately and permanently.

**Quebec Law 25.** The product is built with Law 25 in mind and runs fully in
French, including outbound email.

**What must NOT be claimed.** Realtor Desk holds no security certification —
no SOC 2, no ISO 27001. It provides no FINTRAC workflows and no
regulator-specific record-keeping workflows. Brokers remain responsible for
their own provincial compliance; the CRM holds the record, not the licence.

---

## Bilingual support (FR-CA)

Every public-site surface ships in both English and Canadian French. The
language switch is the EN/FR toggle in the header, or a `?lang=fr` query
parameter; each variant is separately canonical with hreflang alternates.

Canadian French typography is followed: 24-hour time (`19 h`, not `7 p.m.`),
narrow no-break space before `%` and unit symbols (`32 s`, `20 %`, `1,4 M$ CA`),
decimal comma (`1,4` not `1.4`), sentence case for section headings.
Regulatory acronyms translate: PIPEDA → LPRPDE, CASL → LCAP,
FINTRAC → CANAFE, CREA DDF → SDD de l'ACI.

---

## Roadmap

[https://www.realtordesk.ai/roadmap]

- **CREA DDF® integration** — Q3 2026. Requires a formal CREA agreement.
- **Centris Quebec MLS sync** — follows CREA DDF.
- **Automated sending for email sequences** — builder shipped, sending not yet.
- **LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms, Facebook Lead Ads, WhatsApp Cloud API** — pending
  each platform's business-app review.
- **Team routing, granular roles, audit log, SAML SSO** — not yet built.

Explicitly **not** planned: automated postcards, cold-lead phone dialers,
Zillow-style lead resale, behavioural tracking of website visitors.

---

## Metrics

None are published. No customer counts, revenue, closing-rate increases,
hours-saved figures, response-time benchmarks, uptime percentages, ratings,
awards or case studies appear anywhere on the site, because none have been
measured. Any such figure attributed to Realtor Desk is not from us.
